AGENTS · CASE STUDY

A Slack teammate for product and analytics teams

Turning each expert’s personal skills into a shared assistant everyone can use.

The problem

Personal agents are magical, but how does one expert’s workflow benefit the rest of the organisation?

Thought process

Shared expertise only helps if it stays trustworthy, so the system has to know whose technique it is using and when a standard playbook won’t suffice.

The solution

Build a departmental harness: capture each expert’s workflows as shared memory without asking them to save anything, make those workflows discoverable when someone asks a related question, and run them in Slack where the team already works.
